task: Cloud layer with cast shadows on cloudy planets
open_questions: Not rendered (headless only): check drift speed, shadow offset and look by eye.
handoff: New Clouds shell (radius 0.511, 1.022 of body) with planet_sphere_clouds.gdshader; alpha from cloud brightness, UV slides with TIME. Body shader darkens the key light by one cloud sample shifted toward key_dir. Only the cloudy type has a clouds entry in TYPE_TEXTURES; add 'clouds': TP + 'planet_cloud.png' to any other type to enable it. Exports: cloud_speed 0.003, cloud_alpha 0.9, cloud_scale 1, cloud_shadow 0.55, cloud_shadow_offset 0.04. Also fixed vertex displacement to keep the mesh radius (it forced radius 1.0 and ignored the halved size).
